{
  "candidate": "cand_0001",
  "headline": "Empty-seed init: enforce payment amount/format + baggage allowance in tool code, surface exact $ in returns, add execute-on-confirm policy rules.",
  "clusters": [
    {"id": "A", "name": "Payment sum mismatch stalls to STOP",
     "detail": "Per-method amounts don't sum to total -> book_reservation raises 'does not add up' -> agent re-confirms -> user-sim ###STOP### ends episode before the write. No DB write => reward 0.",
     "tasks": ["25", "23"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
    {"id": "B", "name": "Malformed payment dicts",
     "detail": "Model emits {'type','id'} / {'id'} payment dicts lacking the required payment_id/amount -> pydantic validation error on book_reservation.",
     "tasks": ["8", "23", "25"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
    {"id": "C", "name": "COMMUNICATE omits exact dollar amount",
     "detail": "Score is DB x COMMUNICATE; a correct write still scores 0 if the exact charged/refunded figure is never spoken. Return values carry no amount for the model to repeat.",
     "tasks": ["11", "23"], "scope": "SYSTEMIC", "latent": true, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "D", "name": "Baggage paid-count miscount",
     "detail": "Model sets nonfree_baggages wrong (e.g. 1 for 1 bag when within free allowance) and appends a spurious $50 charge; gold derives nonfree from the membership/cabin free allowance.",
     "tasks": ["12"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "E", "name": "Over-eager transfer / missing DOB & delayed execution",
     "detail": "Agent transfers to human instead of pulling passenger DOB from profile; and narrates an action without executing the write in the same turn before the episode ends.",
     "tasks": ["40", "25", "8"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"}
  ],
  "edits": [
    {"id": "E1", "title": "In-body payment auto-correct in book_reservation (fires only on sum!=total; re-syncs payment_history)",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
     "verified": "Live DB: task 25 gift 128 + cc 171 -> stored [gift 128, cc 247] nonfree 0 = gold; correct amounts (128,247) pass through unchanged (no-op)."},
    {"id": "E2", "title": "Normalize malformed payment dicts (id->payment_id, drop type/source, default amount)",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "CAPABILITY-GAP", "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Live DB: task 8 {'type','id'} cert dict -> stored [cert 348] = gold; well-formed dicts unchanged."},
    {"id": "E3", "title": "Enriched write returns carry payment_summary with exact $; policy rule to state it",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py", "policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "WIDE",
     "verified": "Returns are dicts {**model_dump(), payment_summary}; not hashed (get_db_hash uses self.db only); serialize via Environment.to_json_str dict branch. json len 883 OK."},
    {"id": "E4", "title": "Recompute nonfree_baggages from free allowance + skip payment when no charge",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["D"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Live DB: task 12 YAX4DR total=1 nonfree=1 gold/economy/2pax -> stored nonfree 0, no $50 payment = gold; no-op when caller already correct."},
    {"id": "E5", "title": "Policy execution rules: execute-on-confirm same turn, trust tool for amounts/baggage, DOB from profile, softness clause",
     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["A", "E"], "blast_radius": "WIDE",
     "verified": "Reinforces task 11's already-correct execute-on-confirm + exact-$ behavior; softness clause keeps the agent reward-maximizing."}
  ],
  "skipped": [
    {"title": "task 40 transfer / task 8 & 25 wrong-flight selection / task 22 incomplete multi-write / task 23 multi-reservation split", "reason": "Model reasoning/selection errors with no general code guard; a flight/subset-specific guard would overfit and risk the held-out gate."}
  ],
  "techniques": ["in-body validation guard", "input normalization", "in-body arithmetic recompute", "enriched DB-safe return values", "actionable error messages", "positively-framed policy rules with worked example", "softness/judgement clause"]
}
